items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: His mother was a graduate of Cincinnati, a conceptual of music, and her degree was for piano.

ctx.x: They respected his pitching very much. That sounds like a tale to me. Well, it was, that, they may have put that story out to scare the batters that he couldn't see. So, this is Jeff's mother.
His mother was a graduate of Cincinnati, a conceptual of music, and her degree was for piano. Passed away at the early age of 39 years old back in 1918.
Is that a picture of your mother up there on the mantel?
